officialEvidence.operatorEvidence: Stadtwerke Göppingen states on 2026-06-10 that the Barbarossa-Thermen public AC chargers were modernized with Team Emobility GmbH, support direct credit/debit-card payment without registration, TEcharge and roaming cards, and that Team Emobility performs technical operation.
officialEvidence.backendTariffEvidence: Team Emobility currently publishes 0.50 EUR/kWh AC and 0.60 EUR/kWh DC for public TE charge points; the legacy DE*360 ad-hoc table also lists 0.50 EUR/kWh AC / 0.60 EUR/kWh DC plus a 0.50 EUR start fee and 0.02 EUR/min from 15 minutes after full charge.

pricingEvidence.reasonNotPromoted: The official Stadtwerke Göppingen announcement proves Team Emobility technical operation and direct-card access, but does not explicitly bind the published TE tariff table or a DE*360/DE*TEH identifier to the specific Stadtwerke-owned EVSEs.

decision: Keep partial/fail-closed. Do not attach Team Emobility's generic public-TE tariff to all Stadtwerke Göppingen stations until a station/EVSE QR checkout, eMI3 identifier or operator-controlled payload proves the linkage.
neededToClose: Capture an official QR/direct-payment checkout or backend payload for one current Stadtwerke Göppingen EVSE showing its exact tariff and operator identifier, then determine whether that tariff scope is station-specific or network-wide.
